integrity: The two standalone verification programs and complete symmetry representatives are supplied with this classification. No independent external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the Pappus graph of order eighteen, not an infinite graph class.
All results are established by reproducible exact finite enumeration and are not independently audited.
The all-singleton secure-domination subcase was in an earlier computational report and is not claimed new.
Historical priority beyond inspected materials remains uncertain.
title: Mixed-guard weak Roman optima on the Pappus graph: twenty symmetry types and two relocation metrics
